log_cerro_sola: The last session closed by itself
pista_01: they clump on their own; the hard part isn't finding them, it's the timing
pista_02: the cluster breaks up after each wave: let it form again
pista_03: with the group this tight, tapping nonstop is what kills you
pista_04: tap a circle and let the wave do the rest
pista_05: look for four together, don't tap the first one you see
pista_06: each link is worth more than the last
pista_07: you can have several chains at once, each with its own count
pista_08: they fall slowly, swaying; the field refills from the top
pista_09: the fall lines them up by itself: wait for the column to gather
pista_10: you don't score here, you survive
pista_11: they all drift the same way: let the current gather them
pista_12: the best moment is just before they leave the edge
pista_13: one miss and it's over; they all go the same way, no excuses
pista_14: there are many and they're slow: let them gather
pista_15: in this crowd, twelve in a row is just picking well
pista_16: they keep coming: picking who to tap is never the problem here
pista_17: they bump into each other, so groups fall apart on their own
pista_18: aim where they're going to be, not where they are
pista_19: a collision can hand you the chain or ruin it
pista_20: they move in bursts: watch where they dart to, not where they are
pista_21: groups last an instant; tap the moment they form
pista_22: one miss and it's over, and they won't hold still
pista_23: they flee your blasts: catch the neighbours before they get away
pista_24: each wave scatters what you were hunting; chain short and often
pista_25: it only falls if you catch them before they react
pista_26: they fall spinning; big and slow, make the most of it
pista_27: the fall lines them into columns: wait for the fullest one
pista_28: the kindest biome in the game, use it to breathe
pista_29: they rise instead of falling; the eye takes a while to adjust
pista_30: they bunch up as they rise: halfway up is the best moment
pista_31: one miss and it's over, and here everything goes up
pista_32: they pause an instant before turning: that's your moment
pista_33: they're hard to gather; when three line up, don't think
pista_34: they come in from all four sides: don't stare at just one
pista_35: they only turn ninety degrees: for once you can predict them
pista_36: junctions are where they meet; wait for the junction
pista_37: the junctions are yours if you can wait for them
pista_38: they glide and bank slowly; no stretch is quite straight
pista_39: watch them a full second before deciding which to tap
pista_40: the city is still lit below; up here you just have to hold on
pista_41: they rise slowly from the water; take your time
pista_42: they bunch up as they rise: wait for the column to gather
pista_43: no rush here, just hold on
pista_44: they rise and leave: the one you let go is gone
pista_45: the sway gathers and splits them; tap when they cross
pista_46: no rush here, but no second chances either
pista_47: they fall on the city: if one hits the ground, it's over
pista_48: they zigzag, so where they are now isn't enough
pista_50: they're all headed for Earth: if one lands, it's over
pista_51: they speed up as they fall, so the one you ignore comes back worse
pista_52: the last one. Survive the whole shower
